body: SCA-IQ（姊妹站）新增「合作機會」頁：涵蓋 12 個市場、三層對象（競品／治療型／製造生態系）共 68 家的合作角度分析與市場覆蓋地圖。MSA 領域的細胞治療與 CDMO 生態系與 SCA 高度重疊，相關對象一併收錄於該頁並標記「亦與 MSA 相關」。
note: → 細胞治療的製造與供應鏈是跨疾病共用的，兩站不重複維護同一份合作分析。

en.body: SCA-IQ has added a Partnering tab: a partnering assessment and market coverage map spanning 68 companies across 12 markets and three layers (rivals, therapeutic developers, and the manufacturing ecosystem). Cell therapy and CDMO ecosystems overlap heavily between MSA and SCA, so the relevant counterparties are covered there and flagged as also relevant to MSA.
en.note: Manufacturing and supply chains in cell therapy are shared across diseases, so the same partnering analysis is not maintained twice.

body: 掃描盤點目前已登錄的 α-synuclein PET 造影示蹤劑臨床研究，MSA 均列為目標族群：MODAG GmbH 的 [¹⁸F]MODAG-009（NCT07640555，Early Ph1，n=13，收案中，美國 Institute for Neurodegenerative Disorders／XingImaging，主要指標 SUVR，主要完成估 2027/05）與 [¹¹C]MODAG-005 再測信度先導研究（NCT07640542，Early Ph1，尚未收案）；另有 Synusight Biotech（上海）的 SST001（NCT07604116，Ph1，2026/05 起收案，評估安全性、生物分佈、輻射劑量與藥動）。
note: → 這些是造影示蹤劑而非治療藥物，故未列入試驗雷達。MSA 目前缺乏可在活體量化 α-synuclein 病理負荷的工具，臨床試驗多依賴 UMSARS 與腦部體積等間接指標；若示蹤劑取得驗證，將影響未來試驗的受試者分層與藥效藥理終點設計。

en.body: The sweep took stock of the α-synuclein PET tracer studies currently registered, all of which include MSA as a target population: MODAG GmbH's [¹⁸F]MODAG-009 (NCT07640555, Early Ph1, n=13, recruiting at the Institute for Neurodegenerative Disorders / XingImaging in the US, SUVR as the primary measure, primary completion estimated 2027/05) and its [¹¹C]MODAG-005 test-retest pilot (NCT07640542, Early Ph1, not yet recruiting); plus Synusight Biotech (Shanghai)'s SST001 (NCT07604116, Ph1, recruiting since 2026/05, assessing safety, biodistribution, radiation dosimetry and pharmacokinetics).
en.note: → These are imaging tracers rather than treatments, so they are not listed on the trial radar. MSA currently lacks a tool for quantifying α-synuclein pathology in living patients, and trials rely on indirect measures such as UMSARS and brain volume; a validated tracer would change how future trials stratify participants and design pharmacodynamic endpoints.

body: Alterity ATH434 公布 FDA End-of-Phase-2 會議紀錄，確認 MSA 註冊路徑：Ph3 約 200 人、1:1 隨機 50mg 或安慰劑、每日兩次共 12 個月，主要終點 11 項 UMSARS Part I，次要終點含吞嚥障礙問卷、姿勢性低血壓症狀評估與 CGI-S；FDA 同意單一樞紐試驗加確認性證據即可支持核准。
note: → 公司稱 2026 年底前啟動 Ph3 作業。這是 MSA 領域少見已與 FDA 就樞紐設計取得一致的案例。

en.body: Alterity's ATH434 released FDA End-of-Phase-2 meeting minutes confirming its registrational pathway in MSA: a Ph3 of roughly 200 patients randomised 1:1 to 50mg or placebo twice daily for 12 months, with the 11-item UMSARS Part I as the primary endpoint and secondary endpoints including the Swallowing Disturbance Questionnaire, the Orthostatic Hypotension Symptom Assessment and CGI-S. The FDA agreed that a single pivotal trial plus confirmatory evidence could support approval.
en.note: → The company says Ph3 activities will begin by the end of 2026. Few MSA programmes have reached explicit FDA alignment on a pivotal design.

body: 小野藥品 ONO-2808（S1P5 促效劑）於世界帕金森大會發表 Ph2 24 週核心數據：MSA-P 次族群 mUMSARS 變化 安慰劑 3.90 vs 高劑量 1.16；規劃樞紐 Ph3。
note: → 非 α-synuclein 標的的第二個正面訊號；屬次族群分析。

en.body: Ono's ONO-2808 (S1P5 agonist) presented 24-week Ph2 core data at the World Parkinson Congress: in the MSA-P subgroup, mUMSARS change was 3.90 on placebo vs 1.16 on the high dose; a pivotal Ph3 is planned.
en.note: → A second positive signal from a non-alpha-synuclein target; based on a subgroup analysis.

body: Lundbeck amlenetug 的 Ph3 MASCOT（NCT06706622）已停止收案、試驗進行中，主要完成預估 2028/02——目前 MSA 唯一在跑的 Ph3 疾病修飾試驗。
note: → Ph2 AMULET 主要終點未達（減緩 19%、未達顯著）仍進 Ph3。

en.body: Lundbeck's amlenetug Ph3 MASCOT (NCT06706622) has closed enrolment and is ongoing, with primary completion estimated 2028/02 — currently the only Ph3 disease-modifying trial running in MSA.
en.note: → It advanced despite the Ph2 AMULET missing its primary endpoint (19% slowing, not significant).

body: Mayo Clinic 鞘內自體 MSC 的隨機雙盲安慰劑對照 Ph2（NCT05167721）進行中，主要完成預估 2026/12——MSA 細胞治療的關鍵驗證。
note: → 先前 Ph1/2（n=24）對照為歷史配對；此試驗補上同期安慰劑對照。

en.body: Mayo Clinic's intrathecal autologous MSC randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled Ph2 (NCT05167721) is ongoing, with primary completion estimated 2026/12 — the pivotal test for cell therapy in MSA.
en.note: → The earlier Ph1/2 (n=24) used matched historical controls; this trial adds a concurrent placebo.
